features.behaviour: yue-server answers GPU-free score questions: apply ops, validate, measure tokens and duration, return a bar map
acceptance: The 39 golden cases in pipeline/spikes/SP-2-planner-quality/golden.json (10 library sidecars, 29 mutations) give the same ok/error text from the route as from upstream parse_abc/compare (pytest in yue-server)

Edge: library sidecar 0a7cff01 returns ok false with the upstream message ('group 60, Ins: expected V: Ins'); an overfull bar returns the per-bar unit sum with numbers, not only 'event after the measure end'

Applying SET_TEMPO, REHARMONIZE (root + quality enums, 15 native qualities) and EDIT_STYLE returns the edited ABC, per-op verdicts and a style text with the bpm rewritten together with Q: (R-018); the Vocal melody is unchanged per upstream compare
The token count is taken with chords kept (not /v1/scores/measure's stripped count); duration is bars x meter / Q:
While a YuE2 job runs, a call to each route returns in under 1 s, loads no model and leaves nvidia-smi memory within 50 MB of before

features.behaviour: The server decides whether a song can be score-edited, and says why not; the check is repeated at commit
acceptance: Vitest table: YuE2 first take + one layer + no repaint version + sidecar passing the validator + chords present = eligible

Each of these is ineligible with its own reason: second layer, a repaint version, no sidecar, sidecar failing parse_abc (0a7cff01), chord-free score; an ACE-Step or import song is hidden, not ineligible
Edge: eligible at plan time, then a repaint is queued and lands before APPLY & RENDER: the commit is refused with 'this song changed since the plan', and no yue-server job is started
Opening the SCORE verb on a YuE2 song with a repaint version shows the reason line in the app (manual)

features.behaviour: A typed request becomes a validated plan of SET TEMPO / REHARMONIZE / EDIT STYLE ops, planned by a local Ollama model
acceptance: Request body to Ollama carries a strict JSON-schema response_format built per request (bar and section bounds from the song) and reasoning_effort 'none' (Vitest on the client module); default model qwen3:14b, overridable by LLM_MODEL

Live: for 3 library songs, 'set it to 88 BPM' and 'jazz chords in the chorus' each yield a plan whose ops apply and pass the validator within 3 attempts; first-try and attempt counts are logged (SP-2 saw 97% and 100%); any miss is reported, not hidden

Edge: an op naming bar 999 or a section that does not exist is rejected with a per-op reason, fed back to the planner on the next attempt, and after 3 attempts the job ends in 'check failed' with those reasons (Vitest with a stub planner)
The plan job holds one genQueue slot for all attempts and the unload: a repaint submitted meanwhile waits behind it and does not start between attempts (Vitest on genQueue order)
A running plan with the new queue kind 'plan' does not break the Activity drawer or the Header's /active poll (it renders a generic row or none; unit test)

features.behaviour: The planner is unloaded and the GPU confirmed free before YuE2 can start; a truncated prompt is never planned against
acceptance: After the last attempt (success or failure) the server calls Ollama keep_alive 0, polls /api/ps every 250 ms until models is empty, and only then releases the slot (Vitest with a stub that keeps the model listed for 3 polls)

Live on this machine: /api/ps empty within 5 s of the unload ack (SP-1: 0.1 s); VRAM within 0.3 GB of a baseline read just before the plan call; the next YuE2 render runs at 80 tok/s or more (SP-1: 86-95)

Edge: with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=2048 and a long song, the plan is refused with 'planner context is 2048, needs about N: set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=16384' and no plan is shown (the SP-2 silent-truncation case: HTTP 200, normal reply, prompt_eval_count about half the context)
Edge: a model still listed after 10 s ends the plan in an error naming the model and 'ollama stop <model>', releases the slot, and APPLY & RENDER later refuses while /api/ps lists any model
Edge: an LLM_API_URL that is not Ollama (no /api/ps) is reported as unsupported with the reason, not planned against

features.behaviour: A SCORE verb in the Editor action dock: type a request, see the plan as a change list with checks and a consequence line
acceptance: The dock shows a fifth verb tab SCORE only for a song whose base came from YuE2 and only when LLM_API_URL is set; an ACE-Step song and an install without LLM_API_URL show four tabs as today (manual + Vitest on the verb list)

Asking 'jazz chords in the chorus, 88 BPM' shows states queued/planning (attempt n of 3) then a change list with one row per op (e.g. 'SET TEMPO 87 to 88 BPM', 'REHARMONIZE bars 17-24'), a checks line (bars, estimated seconds of 360, tokens of 4,096, chords valid) and the consequence line; nothing is saved at this point (manual: VERSIONS unchanged)

The consequence line is composed from the plan: a SET TEMPO-only plan has no 'request, not a guarantee' clause; a plan with REHARMONIZE says harmony is a request to YuE2, not a guarantee, and says every bar will sound different (manual, two plans)
Edge: editing the request and pressing PLAN again replaces the plan; the old plan is shown dimmed until the new one arrives; an invalid plan keeps APPLY & RENDER disabled
DESIGN.md's Action dock section is updated in the same PR, as its own commit; keys R/L/S/E keep working and the new verb's key does not collide (stage 5 design tasks DT-1..DT-5)

features.behaviour: The review refuses plans that cannot render whole: too long, too many tokens, or no change
acceptance: Estimated duration from bars x meter / Q: is shown; above 330 s a rust warning, at 360 s or more the APPLY & RENDER commit is off with the number and the answer ('estimated 458 s: over the 360 s limit; at least 112 BPM fits'), checked with 88 BPM on the 145 BPM library cover (SP-2 saw 458 s)
The token check counts with chords kept and refuses above 4,096

Edge: a request the three ops cannot express ('make it sadder') yields either an EDIT STYLE-only plan clearly labelled as a style change or 'this request did not change the score or the style' with APPLY & RENDER off; never an empty render
On the M0 live run the estimate is within 5% of the rendered duration (SP-3: 0.6-3.2% short of nominal)

features.behaviour: APPLY & RENDER re-renders the whole song on YuE2 from the edited score and saves it as a new base version
acceptance: The YuE2 job body has abc = the edited score, cot 'full', the stored style (bpm rewritten if SET TEMPO), the stored lyrics untouched, and the base version's seed (Vitest on the request builder; the existing buildYue2CoverRequest and its cot 'melody' stay unchanged)

The result is a new base version with its own .abc sidecar, Q/K/M read into metadata, the layer's previous version still in VERSIONS; reverting to it restores the previous sidecar, lyrics and style (server test + manual)
Re-checks at click time: eligibility, base version unchanged, plan alive, /api/ps empty; each refusal names its reason and starts no engine job
Edge: a 'truncated' job result is shown in rust as TRUNCATED with the length, not as DONE; the version is saved and revertible
Edge: a failed render (yue-server error) creates no version, leaves the base active, keeps the plan reviewable, and shows the error with RETRY RENDER
Edge: CANCEL while rendering aborts, drains the slot as ABORT does today, and creates no version

features.behaviour: Planner problems and cancels read as what happened and what to do
acceptance: LLM_API_URL set but Ollama down: the SCORE body reads PLANNER OFFLINE with RECHECK; model not pulled names 'ollama pull <model>' (stop Ollama and delete the model to check)
CANCEL while queued removes the job and keeps the typed text; CANCEL while planning aborts the call, still unloads and confirms before releasing the slot, and shows no plan (check /api/ps afterwards)
Edge: killing the Ollama process mid-plan ends in the offline state with the cause; the GPU slot is released; the next song action is not blocked
Edge: restarting the Mulakai server between plan and APPLY & RENDER gives 'plan expired, plan again' and starts no job (D-020)

features.behaviour: The M0 exit: the whole promise runs on the real machine and the user hears it
acceptance: Checkpoint CP1 (before the dock UI): a script runs request, plan, apply, render, new version against real Ollama + real yue-server, log kept under pipeline/
In the app: a fresh AN IDEA song on YuE2 (cot full, with chords), SCORE, 'jazz chords in the chorus, 88 BPM', APPLY & RENDER, a new lilac base version appears and plays

Measured and logged: plan latency cold and warm (p50 <= 60 s), attempts, unload-to-empty, VRAM vs pre-plan baseline, YuE2 tok/s >= 80, estimate vs actual duration, truncated flag, tempo from median bar length within 4% of the new Q:, root agreement on the edited bars next to the SP-3 chance level
Edge: repeat once with ACE-Step loaded and idle (offload flags on) and once after a real ACE-Step generation, the SP-1 owed cases
OWED to the user (keeps passes false): A/B base vN-1 vs vN, tempo (expect clearly) and chords (clearly / slightly / no); report the answers

features.behaviour: WRITE PHRASE: 'add a 4-bar sax phrase after it' writes a short instrument line the planner composed as notes
acceptance: The schema takes bars as arrays of {pitch, beats} (beats 0.5/1/1.5/2/3/4), N bars set per request; code writes the ABC and owns units, ties and bar sums; free ABC strings are not accepted anywhere
The phrase lands in Ins only where the Vocal rests; the instrument name is appended to the style; the consequence line says the instrument is a request, not a guarantee
Live on 3 library songs: compound request 'jazz chords in the chorus, 88 BPM, add a 4-bar sax phrase after it' plans valid within 3 attempts (SP-2: 86% qwen3, 100% MoE); attempts logged

Edge: a phrase with fewer than 4 notes, fewer than 3 distinct pitches, under 70% in key or four identical bars is rejected with the reason and retried; beat sums that do not fill a bar are fed back with the numbers
Edge: asking for a phrase where the Vocal does not rest is refused with the bars that are free
OWED: the user's SP-2 phrase listen; if 'not musical' the verb ships the op labelled EXPERIMENTAL (Q to be raised)

features.behaviour: TRANSPOSE: 'down a tone' shifts every note and chord and re-renders in the new key

features.behaviour: REPEAT and CUT a section; lyrics and section tags follow the score
acceptance: REPEAT copies the section literally (no repeat signs), un-ties the seam (library f3e3bfdc), duplicates the matching lyric block; CUT removes both; tags are rewritten from the edited score's '% section' comments, the planner never writes tags (R-018)
The review names the section to cut when a repeat would pass the duration limit ('cut the outro 0:32 to fit')
Edge: a section with no matching lyric block (2c944049's one chorus vs two [Chorus] blocks) follows the stated rule, shown in the change list, not a silent guess
Live: a repeated chorus renders with bar count equal to the score's and the copy matching the first (SP-3: 0.95-0.99)

features.behaviour: REWRITE LYRICS for one block, keeping the line count and the tags
acceptance: Addressed by block number and tag occurrence; same number of lines, no tags written by the planner; the diff of the lyrics is shown in the change list
Edge: a request naming 'the second chorus' resolves to the right block in the change list before it is applied (SP-2: qwen3 64% right block, so the row shows which block it will change)
The review says the new words need a re-render of the whole song
